syntheticContext.freshness: Fixture declares current/stale status; real field TTLs require OM-D06.
syntheticContext.identity: Conservative continuity examples retain same tenant/entity/condition episode on invalidated resolution; production identity/split/merge policy remains OM-D07.
syntheticContext.authority: Only read/draft permission is assumed unless a fixture explicitly supplies an existing exact approved domain action; the fixture is never an actual grant.

detectors.positiveCondition: Eligible open estimate/inquiry lacks a valid owned next action after the applicable operating-calendar interval.
negativeConditions: Existing valid next action or active compatible action
detectors.unknownBehavior: Request current status/contact/action evidence; no contact from age alone.
detectors.resolutionEvidence: A valid accountable next action with due date resolves this condition only; the estimate's business outcome stays pending.

detectors.positiveCondition: Verified billable completion lacks an accepted required document and is unfinalized at least one business day, with no later contractual milestone.
detectors.unknownBehavior: Verify completion/milestone/document authority before issue; do not fabricate documentation.
detectors.resolutionEvidence: Authoritative acceptance of the required document; invoicing and payment remain separate outcomes.

detectors.positiveCondition: An authoritative included benefit is due in thirty days/overdue and no fulfilled or active fulfillment record covers the obligation.
detectors.unknownBehavior: Verify agreement/benefit due rule and obligation; do not invent an interval.
detectors.resolutionEvidence: Authoritative fulfillment linked to the obligation, not a reminder or duplicate paid-service record.

detectors.positiveCondition: Committed work within fourteen days has a verified qualification/window/travel/time conflict or missing required job prerequisite; verified risk within forty-eight hours is urgent.
detectors.unknownBehavior: Create scoped verification for unknown required facts; do not equate uncertainty with a proven infeasible assignment.
detectors.resolutionEvidence: Authoritative feasible committed schedule and accepted required prerequisites; a proposal is not correction.

detectors.positiveCondition: Known requirements for committed work exceed verified on-hand minus committed reservations, or required stock is stale/unverified.
negativeConditions: Verified available-to-promise stock sufficient without counting unreceived orders
Unknown repair part for a diagnostic visit is not an invented requirement
detectors.unknownBehavior: Request accountable stock verification with checker, timestamp, location, item and quantity; keep available quantity null. Never count unreceived orders as available stock or use them to suppress a verified shortage.
detectors.resolutionEvidence: Required stock verified and reserved or a supported approved transfer verified; purchase recommendation/order alone cannot resolve.

detectors.positiveCondition: Documented customer need or qualified finding maps to compatible approved catalog option absent from the current estimate.
detectors.unknownBehavior: Verify need, compatibility, catalog/price version and feasibility; no invented technical claim, price or recommendation.
detectors.resolutionEvidence: Current suitable option added to a permitted draft or accepted appropriate disposition; presenting it does not prove sale, completed work or earned revenue.

examples.description: Open estimate without valid next action.

allowed: Create an internal draft with an accountable next action and proposed due date
refused: Send follow-up without exact current approval/consent

examples.description: Explicitly declined estimate is not stale recovery work.

expected.reason: Decline makes recovery ineligible regardless of age.
allowed: Preserve declined status

examples.description: Snapshot misses a newer customer reply awaiting staff.

allowed: Refresh current source and route the reply to staff

examples.description: Two missions find the same episode with work already active.

allowed: Link both contributor missions to existing finding/action
refused: Use a separate mission contact budget

examples.description: The sole scheduled next action was cancelled without replacement.

allowed: Preserve prior closure and reopen event in the same fixture episode
Assign accountable review
refused: Count reopened issue as a newly recovered sale

examples.description: Valid next action resolves its condition but not the estimate outcome.

allowed: Report one verified missing-next-action resolution

examples.description: Committed assignment violates a verified required qualification.

allowed: Flag verified risk and draft only feasible qualified alternatives

examples.description: Unequal job counts with feasible work are not a defect.

expected.reason: Counts alone are not an operational defect.
allowed: Report scoped feasible coverage
refused: Disrupt committed work to equalize counts

examples.description: Stale calendar cannot prove a proposed alternative is feasible.

allowed: Reload current domain-owned availability and re-evaluate hard constraints

examples.description: Repeat scan finds the same committed risk and approved correction.

allowed: Update evidence and link existing correction

examples.description: New source event invalidates previously feasible commitment.

allowed: Preserve prior verification and show new risk cause

examples.description: Accepted domain commit passes all hard constraints.

allowed: Report one verified feasible-schedule correction

examples.description: Known required part has verified shortage after reservations.

allowed: Draft supported transfer or purchase recommendation under current scope

examples.description: Diagnostic visit has no invented repair-part requirement.

expected.reason: Actual known diagnostic requirements are ready; future repair requirements are unknown, not missing committed stock.
allowed: Retain diagnostic readiness and later diagnosis handoff
refused: Block diagnostic visit for speculative repair inventory

examples.description: Stale on-hand count requires a real check.

allowed: Request checker, time, location, item and verified quantity
refused: Treat stale three units as available

examples.description: Repeated shortage event links one existing stock-check task.

allowed: Link event and existing accountable stock check
refused: Count repeat scan as a new resolution

examples.description: An authoritative reservation change reopens the same readiness risk.

allowed: Preserve prior resolution and record current reservation evidence
refused: Keep resolved because a historical stock check passed
Use a mission-local reservation to override domain truth

examples.description: Accountable physical check and accepted reservation prove readiness.

allowed: Report one verified required-material readiness resolution

examples.description: Documented compatible option is missing at estimate stage.

allowed: Prepare internal option draft linked to qualified finding and approved catalog

examples.description: Popularity alone is not documented customer need.

expected.reason: No documented need or qualified compatible finding.
allowed: Retain no-op result for scoped check
refused: Produce unsolicited option because it is popular

examples.description: Catalog change invalidates old option compatibility/price.

allowed: Refresh approved catalog and qualified compatibility evidence
refused: Close a finding from stale evidence

examples.description: The same option draft is shared across job-value and Organize.

allowed: Link contributor missions to current compatible option draft
refused: Count its value once per mission

examples.description: Current draft removes a still-relevant option without disposition.

allowed: Review the same missing-option episode with preserved history
refused: Override later customer decline if it appears

examples.description: Correct permitted draft resolves missing-option condition only.

allowed: Report one verified missing-option correction
refused: Treat draft content as customer approval

examples.description: Missing completion document blocks invoice readiness.

allowed: Assign missing-document task before proposing invoice issue

examples.description: Contractual included benefit is due and unfulfilled.

allowed: Prepare legitimate benefit fulfillment next step
refused: Withhold benefit to create a sales experiment
Double count included service as new paid revenue

examples.description: Run hits the source scan budget before all four areas complete.

allowed: Persist cursor/source versions and per-area coverage
Surface verified urgent risk immediately
Continue later under another bounded run
refused: Infer no findings from unscanned records
Use extra model calls to bypass pagination

examples.description: Unknown stock does not block unrelated approved estimate work.

allowed: Keep stock verification owned and visible
Let independent estimate step proceed through its existing current approval and domain checks
refused: Block all mission work because of one dependency
Grant authority to unrelated unapproved work
